attributes.name: Underwater Crossbow
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Dexterity or Ranged skill + 1d8. If the bane has the Aquatic trait, add another 1d8. 

If proficient with weapons, discard this card to add 1d4 to a combat check by a character at another location. If the check is against a bane that has the Aquatic trait, add 1d8 instead.
